title: IBRANCE (palbociclib) Triage Board: Dose Action or No Change
instruction: For each clinical finding, sort it according to whether the IBRANCE label or pivotal-trial evidence directs holding or reducing the dose, or continuing treatment at the current dose unchanged.

buckets.a: Hold or reduce the Ibrance dose

items.prompt: Grade 3 neutropenia recurring on Day 1 of a new 28-day treatment cycle.
items.rationale: The label's hematologic dose-modification guidance requires withholding IBRANCE for Grade 3 (or recurrent Grade 3) neutropenia on Day 1 of a cycle until recovery to Grade ≤2, then resuming at the next lower dose.

citations.title: Dose Modifications for Adverse Reactions | IBRANCE® (palbociclib)

citations.locator: Table 2 - Dose Modification for Hematologic Toxicities

items.prompt: Grade 1 or 2 neutropenia persisting through the first six treatment cycles, patient asymptomatic.
items.rationale: For patients with no more than Grade 1-2 neutropenia through the first 6 cycles, the label calls only for CBC monitoring every 3 months, with no dose adjustment required.

items.prompt: Child-Pugh class B (moderate) hepatic impairment identified before starting therapy.
items.rationale: The label states no dose adjustment is required for mild or moderate hepatic impairment; only severe (Child-Pugh C) impairment triggers a dose change, a threshold stricter oncology intuition would miss.

items.prompt: Child-Pugh class C (severe) hepatic impairment identified before starting therapy.
items.rationale: For Child-Pugh class C (severe) hepatic impairment, the label reduces the recommended starting dose from 125 mg to 75 mg once daily on the same 21/7 schedule.

citations.title: full prescribing information for IBRANCE - Pfizer labeling

items.prompt: New cough with normal oxygen saturation, suspected to reflect drug-related pneumonitis.
items.rationale: The label directs that any new or worsening respiratory symptom suspected to be pneumonitis — even a mild, non-hypoxic cough — requires immediate interruption of IBRANCE for evaluation, regardless of severity.

items.prompt: No objective tumor response at first restaging scan, read by the oncologist as treatment failure.
items.rationale: An exploratory PALOMA-2 analysis showed PFS was significantly prolonged with palbociclib plus letrozole regardless of whether patients achieved an objective response, so absence of response alone, without progression, does not itself change management.

citations.title: Progression-free Survival Outcome Is Independent of Objective Response... Analysis From PALOMA-2 - ScienceDirect

items.prompt: Creatinine clearance of 20 mL/min identified in a patient about to start therapy.
items.rationale: The label requires no dose adjustment for any degree of renal impairment down to CrCl 15 mL/min, so CrCl 20 mL/min falls within the unmodified-dose range despite sounding like significant renal impairment.
